# Bolton Place Detached Homes — full briefing
Independent information resource for boltonplacedetached.com. Not affiliated with Opus Homes.
Last updated: 2026-09-06

## What is Bolton Place?
Bolton Place is a pre-construction community by Opus Homes near The Gore Road and King Street in Bolton, part of the Town of Caledon, Ontario, planned to offer townhomes and detached homes. It is currently in a registration-only, Coming Soon stage.

## Who is building Bolton Place?
Bolton Place is being built by Opus Homes, a GTA-area homebuilder also behind other pre-construction communities such as Founders Walk, and a joint partner with Arista Homes and Deco Homes on the separate SouthCal Homes community elsewhere in Caledon.

## Is Bolton Place part of Caledon Station?
Bolton Place is sometimes referenced as 'Bolton Place at Caledon Station,' suggesting a connection to the wider Caledon Station master-planned area, but this relationship has not been independently confirmed. Buyers should confirm directly with Opus Homes whether Bolton Place is part of the same master plan or a separate, similarly-named project.

## How much do homes cost at Bolton Place?
Opus Homes has not released pricing for Bolton Place as of this page's last update. Buyers who register for updates typically receive pricing information first when it is released.

## What home types are available at Bolton Place?
Bolton Place is planned to include townhomes and single-family detached homes, according to public listing sources. Specific floor plans and sizes have not been released.

## Where is Bolton Place located?
Bolton Place is located near The Gore Road and King Street in Bolton, a community within the Town of Caledon, Ontario.

## When will Bolton Place launch?
Opus Homes has not announced a firm public launch date for Bolton Place. The project is currently in a registration-only, Coming Soon stage.

## Is Bolton Place a good investment?
As pricing for Bolton Place has not been released, a specific investment case can't yet be made with real numbers. Bolton's location within Caledon, where Greenbelt legislation limits future developable land, is generally cited as a favourable long-term supply dynamic across the town's pre-construction communities.

## Who is Opus Homes?
Opus Homes is a GTA-area homebuilder active on multiple pre-construction communities, including Bolton Place and Founders Walk, and a joint builder (alongside Arista Homes and Deco Homes) on the SouthCal Homes community elsewhere in Caledon.

## How do I register for updates on Bolton Place?
Register directly on this site with your first name, last name, email, and phone number to be added to the Bolton Place update list.

## What detached home options will Bolton Place offer?
Bolton Place is planned to include single-family detached homes alongside its townhome collection, per public listing sources. Specific lot widths, sizes, and plan names have not been released. This site is a detached-homes spotlight for buyers who have already decided against a townhome.

## Unverified
Whether Bolton Place is part of the Argo Development Corp Caledon Station master plan has not been independently confirmed. Do not treat aggregator amenity lists copied from that master plan as Opus Homes specifications for Bolton Place.

## Pricing, deposits, occupancy
All unreleased. Render as to be announced. No unit count is stated because none has been found.
